licence.attribution: Supreme Court of Canada

sources._note: Arising from Air Canada Flight 624, Halifax, March 2015. The manufacturer sought the recording under s.28(6); the Board opposed on statutory privilege. The motion judge examined it in camera, found the public interest in the proper administration of justice outweighed the privilege, and ordered release. Affirmed on appeal; the Supreme Court dismissed the Board's appeal 7-2. An express-bar regime's bar yielding in practice, on the CVR specifically — a direct counterpart to the Brazilian finding, which the divergence section currently says has none.
